# getColumnLetterByPosition

<link-summary>Converts a one-based column position into its letter.</link-summary>

<web-summary>getColumnLetterByPosition() — Converts a one-based column position into its letter. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function getColumnLetterByPosition(columnPosition: number): string;
```

Indices count from zero, the way a `GridRange` does; positions count from one, the way `getRange(row, column)` does. Mixing the two is the usual source of an off-by-one in a spreadsheet script, which is why both pairs exist under separate names.

## Parameters

| Parameter        | Type     | Description                                         |
| :--------------- | :------- | :-------------------------------------------------- |
| `columnPosition` | `number` | The zero-based column position (e.g., `1` for 'A'). |

## Returns

`string` — the column letter.

## Examples

### Converting

```javascript
getColumnLetterByPosition(1); // => "A"
getColumnLetterByPosition(27); // => "AA"
```
